title: Blood: The Last Vampire

guide_target.label: BLOOD THE LAST VAMPIRE 上巻・下巻（2000年オリジナル版）

routes.title: 上巻
routes.notes: Original PlayStation 2 Volume 1 (上巻), released 2000-12-21. Common prologue that every playthrough must clear before Gekan (下巻) unlocks. Contains 19 of its own endings (End01-19 per both Japanese sources) reached through BSS (Blood Search System) taps and timed 2-4 choice menus. Endings 1-15 are dead-end/bad endings of varying severity; endings 16-19 are the four named 'good' endings that let the player choose Continue into Gekan, carrying over BLOOD level and a small number of story flags: End16 闇の王編 (Dark King), End17 灯子編 (Touko), End18 瑠璃亜編 (Rulia), End19 究明編 (Investigation). Three named flags carry from Joukan into Gekan's 瑠璃亜編 branch: 瑠璃亜の過去フラグ, 吸血鬼の本フラグ, and 五匹の子豚さんフラグ. Their exact relationship to the true ending is source-disputed; the current guide follows xneo.jp's explicit Ending 27 input sequence and documents the disagreement below. Gekan also has an internal 'Ooka Report' (大岡レポート) shortcut, available from a Gekan New Game, that lets the player set BLOOD level and these same 3 flags via a short standalone flowchart and jump straight into any of the 4 Gekan route openings without replaying Joukan (does not affect the in-game completion percentage, but is a legitimate way to reach every Gekan route/ending).

routes.title: 闇の王編
routes.notes: Dark King arc. Reached in Joukan via End16, continued in Gekan (下巻) via the 闇の王編 branch, which itself fans out into multiple Gekan endings (e.g. End22 「全ては闇に」, End23 「闇の王編」 per the mmitsuru numbering; xneo.jp's independent numbering places equivalent Dark King endings at its own Endings 5/7/8/12/13/19/22/23 - the two sites number Gekan's 27 endings in a different order, see disagreements). No BLOOD level requirement confirmed for the branch's main outcome; several sub-endings are gated by BLOOD level thresholds (below/above 50, 85, 100) at specific choices.

routes.title: 究明編
routes.notes: Investigation/truth-seeking arc, not tied to a specific heroine. Reached in Joukan via End19, continued in Gekan via the 究明編 branch (mmitsuru End26; several equivalent endings on xneo.jp: Endings 2/3/4/11/14/26). Multiple sub-endings gated by BLOOD level (70/80 thresholds) at the same recurring choice points (tape color picked from the desk drawer, then the escape from the underground base).

routes.title: 灯子編
routes.notes: Touko (灯子) arc. Reached in Joukan via End17, continued in Gekan via the 灯子編 branch (mmitsuru End24; xneo.jp equivalent Endings 6/9/10/24). Touko does not have a VNDB character entry, so no portrait is available.

routes.title: 瑠璃亜編
routes.notes: Rulia (瑠璃亜) arc on the original PS2 下巻, and the branch that leads toward the true ending. Reached in Joukan via the 瑠璃亜編 handoff or directly via 下巻's 大岡レポート shortcut. xneo.jp documents sub-endings 15/16/17/18/20/25/27 on this branch. For Ending 25 specifically, xneo.jp's row omits the four optional B.S.S. results 弱いって……？／瑠璃亜……／どんな人だったの？／ママさんなら…… while still completing the final 瑠璃亜をかばう search; Ending 27 includes all four plus the final search. The route_rulia guide therefore skips those four optional B.S.S. opportunities on its Ending 25 path, while route_true_end performs them.

routes.title: 真・瑠璃亜編
routes.notes: True ending variant of 瑠璃亜編 on the original PS2 下巻. xneo.jp's Ending 27 row uses the same 大岡レポート opening as Ending 25 (including 少年は傷のわけを聞いた) but additionally performs four optional B.S.S. results — 弱いって……？／瑠璃亜……／どんな人だったの？／ママさんなら…… — before also completing the final 瑠璃亜をかばう search. That completion pattern is the current guide's directly verified differentiator from Ending 25. mmitsuru labels its End27 explicitly as 真・瑠璃亜編 but historically documents a conflicting 瑠璃亜の過去フラグ requirement; preserve that as a source disagreement rather than using it to override xneo.jp's explicit Ending 27 sequence.

sources.title: BLOOD THE LAST VAMPIRE上巻完全攻略 (XNEO)
sources.notes: Primary Set A component for 上巻. Complete choice-by-choice walkthrough for all 19 Joukan endings and B.S.S. triggers. The page explicitly identifies the covered title as the PlayStation 2 software released 2000-12-21, matching the guide target exactly.

sources.title: BLOOD THE LAST VAMPIRE下巻完全攻略 (XNEO)
sources.notes: Primary Set A component for 下巻. Complete choice-by-choice walkthrough for all 27 Gekan endings, route labels, B.S.S. triggers, and BLOOD thresholds. It is the companion page to XNEO's explicitly PS2-targeted 上巻 guide and covers the original two-volume PS2 structure.

sources.title: BLOOD THE LAST VAMPIRE - ドラやる？ (mmitsuru), via Wayback Machine
sources.notes: Independent Japanese Set B for both PS2 volumes, recovered through Wayback snapshots of the original mmitsuru walkthrough (index, B.S.S., flag/Ooka pages, joend01-19, geend01-27). The walkthrough material originates from the original PS2-era site; archived pages include captures from 2005, before the January 2006 PSP compilation, so this set applies to the original PS2 release rather than the later PSP re-release. It independently covers route/ending structure and names, although its Gekan ending numbering/branch descriptions differ from xneo.jp in places.

sources.title: Blood: The Last Vampire - Guide and Walkthrough (by Gene, GameFAQs, PSP)
sources.notes: Supplementary English PS2 FAQ by Gene. Directly inspectable and explicitly identifies BLOOD THE LAST VAMPIRE <上巻> (PS2) and <下巻> (PS2) as the two chapters released together on 2000-12-21. Used only as target/provenance corroboration, not as one of the two Japanese verification sets.

disagreements: GUIDE TARGET: original Japanese PlayStation 2 two-volume release (上巻 SCPS-15007 / 下巻 SCPS-15008), released 2000-12-21. This resolves the legacy PS2/PSP ambiguity; the 2006 PSP compilation is not the guide target. Set A (xneo.jp) explicitly identifies the original PS2 release, and Set B's archived walkthrough material predates the PSP compilation. Gekan numbering/branch presentation differs between xneo.jp and mmitsuru, so ending numbers must be matched by their documented choice sequences rather than assumed identical across sites. TRUE ENDING: xneo.jp's explicit Ending 25 vs Ending 27 rows establish a completion-based distinction: Ending 25 skips 弱いって……？／瑠璃亜……／どんな人だったの？／ママさんなら…… but completes 瑠璃亜をかばう; Ending 27 includes all four and also completes 瑠璃亜をかばう. The guide follows that directly verified PS2 sequence. mmitsuru explicitly labels End27 真・瑠璃亜編 but historically documents a conflicting 瑠璃亜の過去フラグ condition; retain this as an unresolved cross-source discrepancy rather than silently forcing one site's flag model onto the other's sequence. TOUKO: neither source confirms whether この土地……？ and いらないよ occur sequentially on one 灯子編 playthrough or represent different early sub-branches; route_touko.json follows the source-backed Touko-specific sequence and records the uncertainty in its enGuide notes. Also, source evidence shows 父さん、ここは？/こんなところに…… belong to the sampled 闇の王編 corridor rather than the 灯子編 rows, so those steps were removed from route_touko.json.
